description: Where a site ranks in Google organic results (top 100) for one to five keywords in one country, desktop or mobile: position, ranking URL, competitor positions, the top 10 and whether the AI Overview cites the site. Billed per keyword checked; a keyword that fails is free. Each check is one live sample. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

competitors.description: Up to 5 competitor domains to report positions for.

country.description: ISO-2 country code of the Google market to check. Defaults to "us".

device.description: Desktop or mobile results. Defaults to desktop.

domain.description: Your site, e.g. example.com. Covers www and subdomains. Omit to get only the top results.

keywords.description: One to five distinct search terms, as people type them into Google. Each is billed separately.

language.description: Optional ISO-2 language code. Defaults to the country's main language.

url.description: Optional page that should rank, as a full URL or a path such as /pricing.

name: cite42_keyword_rankings
